say:1:1411430001:1.text: How dare you guys mock me?!
say:1:1411430001:1.source_cn: 你、你们！你们居然敢这么嘲笑我！

say:2:1411430002:0.text: Who are you calling <shk>weak</shk>?! And what do you mean "<shk>no real threat</shk>"?! You really think you can <shk>take me down that easy</shk>?!
say:2:1411430002:0.source_cn: 什么叫<shk>弱！</shk>什么叫<shk>没有威...
say:2:1411430002:0.male: Who are you calling <shk>weak</shk>?! And what do you mean "<shk>no real threat</shk>"?! You really think you can <shk>take me down that easy</shk>?!
say:2:1411430002:0.female: Who are you calling <shk>weak</shk>?! And what do you mean "<shk>no real threat</shk>"?! You really think you can <shk>take me down that easy</shk>?!

say:3:1411430003:1.text: <shk>Ahhh!</shk> I want to kill you all! You're dead!
say:3:1411430003:1.source_cn: <shk>啊啊啊——我生气了！我生气了！</shk>我...

choice_prompt:4:1411430003.text: <shk>Ahhh!</shk> I want to kill you all! You're dead!
choice_prompt:4:1411430003.source_cn: <shk>啊啊啊——我生气了！我生气了！</shk>我绝对不会放过你们！

say:5:1411430004:1.text: I'm writing down everything you guys said! This is evidence!
say:5:1411430004:1.source_cn: 是你们先说我坏话！我肯定会记下来的！这是证据！
say:5:1411430004:1.male: I'm writing down everything you guys said! This is evidence!
say:5:1411430004:1.female: I'm writing down everything you guys said! This is evidence!

say:6:1411430006:1.text: Do I look like some mortal to you?! I'm a powerful Hypogean! I'll never forgive anyone who snubs me, let alone people who spread this... this... What's the word I'm looking for?
say:6:1411430006:1.source_cn: 我这样伟大的恶魔，绝对不会放过一星半点的仇恨，更不要说...

say:9:1411430008:1.text: Yes, slander! I've already written down all the things you were saying behind my back. It's time for me to get revenge!
say:9:1411430008:1.source_cn: 对！你们背后的诋毁，我已经记下了！我必须要狠狠复仇！

choice_prompt:10:1411430008.text: Yes, slander! I've already written down all the things you were saying behind my back. It's time for me to get revenge!
choice_prompt:10:1411430008.source_cn: 对！你们背后的诋毁，我已经记下了！我必须要狠狠复仇！

say:11:1411430009:1.text: No, I'm not as trashy as you dweebs! I'm a stand-up Hypogean!
say:11:1411430009:1.source_cn: 我才没有你们这么阴暗！我可是堂堂正正的凶暴恶魔！
say:11:1411430009:1.male: No, I'm not as trashy as you dweebs! I'm a stand-up Hypogean!
say:11:1411430009:1.female: No, I'm not as trashy as you dweebs! I'm a stand-up Hypogean!

say:12:1411430010:1.text: I'm going to do evil, awful things to you. You'll suffer horribly! My revenge will be tortuous!
say:12:1411430010:1.source_cn: 我会用恶魔的方式，邪恶！凶暴！强大地向你们复仇！
say:12:1411430010:1.male: I'm going to do evil, awful things to you. You'll suffer horribly! My revenge will be tortuous!
say:12:1411430010:1.female: I'm going to do evil, awful things to you. You'll suffer horribly! My revenge will be tortuous!

say:13:1411430011:1.text: Lady Kulu, do you mean torturous...? Oh, never mind...
say:13:1411430011:1.source_cn: ……库露露大人，强大这个词不是这么用……呃算了。

say:14:1411430012:1.text: I'm going to teach you all a lesson you'll never forget!
say:14:1411430012:1.source_cn: 我一定会给你们颜色瞧瞧，让你们心服口服！

say:15:1411430013:1.text: Yes, Lady Kulu will make you regret your insults!
say:15:1411430013:1.source_cn: 是的！库露露大人一定会让你们悔恨交加，追悔莫及，悔之晚矣！

say:16:1411430014:1.text: Just wait! I'm going to create the biggest bomb in the world!
say:16:1411430014:1.source_cn: 走着瞧吧，我要做一个前所未有的超级大炸弹！！！

choice:10:0:1.text: You want to slander us too?
choice:10:0:1.male: You want to slander us too?
choice:10:0:1.female: You want to slander us too?

say:18:1411430005:1.text: What do you mean eavesdropping?! You were all insulting me! I'm writing this down!
say:18:1411430005:1.source_cn: 什么叫偷听！你们先说我坏话，我只是记下来而已！
say:18:1411430005:1.male: What do you mean eavesdropping?! You were all insulting me! I'm writing this down!
say:18:1411430005:1.female: What do you mean eavesdropping?! You were all insulting me! I'm writing this down!
